title: One successful publish produces exactly one authoritative commit

steps.action: stageContent: cap checks, traversal/symlink checks, write .thirdlight/staging/stg-commit01/source.bin
inspectStage: read the staged bytes, compute SHA-256, validate against the M2 import profile
publishBlob: durably create sources/sha256/<digest> with the workspace.md 5.1 write procedure
command pipeline steps 1-3 under the mutation lock: resolve project/ownership, dedup (no record), pause check
step 4 revision check and steps 5-6 apply+verify the new AssetVersion (referenced blob exists and matches its digest)
step 7 one atomic envelope write: scene revision 8 + new content block + one new retry record
step 9 acknowledge after the directory flush and verification read

durableEffects: envelope revision 8 carries one new AssetVersion with publishedRevision 8
observations: exactly one authoritative commit: the bytes are durable before the command, and only the single envelope replacement is authoritative
the command's args contain no staging handle and no path, so retry replay never depends on staging (content-storage.md 6.1)
no second mutable catalog file is written
the ack follows the envelope commit, never the blob publication

notes: Establishes the acceptance claim "one authoritative commit": the blob is durable before the envelope, and only the envelope commit is authoritative.
